app: launch 1 (CDP 9344), in Play at home: N, leave one note on this local world (so the .world carries a note), read the world's head before and after

actions.eval: (async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return n === null ? 'no world' : { world: n.world, head: n.head.n, notes: (n.notes ?? []).length, sequencer: n.sequencer ?? null } })()
